narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>They share the prime three, so seventy five is divisible by twenty one.
<bookmark mark='gap'/>But twenty one also needs a seven, and seventy five has no seven at all.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>One shared prime is not enough, because every prime of the divisor must be inside.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>If even one prime of the divisor is missing from the number, the number is not divisible.
